mapper.select:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT res.ID_) FROM ACT_HI_PROCINST res LEFT JOIN ACT_RE_PROCDEF def ON res.PROC_DEF_ID_ = def.ID_ LEFT JOIN system_users u ON res.START_USER_ID_ = CAST(u.id AS VARCHAR) LEFT JOIN ACT_HI_TASKINST task ON res.ID_ = task.PROC_INST_ID_
(res.START_USER_ID_ = CAST(#{userId} AS VARCHAR) OR task.ASSIGNEE_ = CAST(#{userId} AS VARCHAR))
AND res.NAME_ LIKE CONCAT('%', #{reqVO.name}, '%')
AND res.ID_ LIKE CONCAT('%', #{reqVO.processInstanceId}, '%')
AND def.KEY_ = #{reqVO.processDefinitionKey}
AND u.nickname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{reqVO.startUserNickname}, '%')
AND res.END_TIME_ IS NULL AND res.END_TIME_ IS NOT NULL
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ACT_HI_VARINST v WHERE v.PROC_INST_ID_ = res.ID_ AND v.NAME_ = #{VAR_SOURCE_UNIT} AND v.TEXT_ LIKE CONCAT('%', #{reqVO.startDeptName}, '%') )
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ACT_HI_VARINST v WHERE v.PROC_INST_ID_ = res.ID_ AND v.NAME_ = #{VAR_DEADLINE} AND ( (v.LONG_ IS NOT NULL AND (CURRENT_DATE - DATE(to_timestamp(v.LONG_ / 1000))) >= #{reqVO.overdueDays}) OR (v.TEXT_ IS NOT NULL AND v.TEXT_ != '' AND (CURRENT_DATE - TO_DATE(v.TEXT_, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) >= #{reqVO.overdueDays}) ) )
AND res.START_TIME_ BETWEEN #{reqVO.createTime[0]} AND #{reqVO.createTime[1]}
